Deep Hydration For Hair - Our powerful combination of natural argan and lemongrass essential oil, mixed with jojoba oil and shea butter, leaves your hair feeling soft and hydrated. Argan Oil can withstand high temperature, and will help protect your hair from the environment and heat styling tools. Silk amino acids, sea buckthorn and shea butter are also deeply moisturizing, giving your hair fibres more strength and hydration, without weighing it down.
Rich In Vitamin A, C & E - Argan oil is packed with vitamins, antioxidants and omega-6 fatty acids, which helps repair and fight damaged hair. This incredible oil, also known as “liquid gold”, is derived from the kernels of the Argan Tree which is native to Morocco. Argan Oil mixed with Lemongrass is a super powered duo that works together to replenish and strengthen hair down to the root, leaving it feeling refreshed and rejuvenated.
Made With Natural Ingredients: Rich in Vitamin A and E, shea butter locks in moisture and increases softness. Keratin helps rebuild the hair's natural protective layer to make it stronger and more elastic. Avocados seal moisture into cuticle cells, reducing breakage and split ends. Coconut oil penetrates deep into your hair shaft to prevent protein loss and breakage. Jojoba oil deeply hydrates individual strands of hair and increases shine.
Protects Against Heat: Don’t ruin your hair from over-using heat styling tools. Argan Oil can withstand high temperatures from blow dryers, curling irons and straighteners, and will help protect your hair from severe thermal damage. Because of argan oil’s nourishing and moisturizing properties, it will work to repair dry and heat damaged hair.
Sulfate, Paraben, Silicone, & Cruelty Free - Aquableu’s Argan Shampoo and Conditioner is made with all-natural ingredients. This ensures you are washing your hair free of harsh chemicals, while removing dirt, oil and chemicals and providing an effective cleanse. We’re proud to say our products are never tested on animals.
